Class CraftTweakerQuery

java.lang.Object
io.github.wurtzitane.avogadro.compat.crafttweaker.CraftTweakerQuery
public final class CraftTweakerQuery extends Object
Lets ZenScript read a fixed view of molecule definitions from an explicitly chosen source.

Select startup, server, or client-display data before querying it. Later reloads do not change the saved view. Use server data for decisions affecting the game; the client view may contain a player's visual overrides.
